purpose: Predeclare the exact user questions, evidence plans, profile boundaries and feasibility gates for Phase 7B without approving production behavior.

anchor_destinations.reason: points/occupation routes, federal regulation and state variation
federal/provincial routes, regulator variation and mature official data
EU/national routes, statutory insurance and regulated-profession recognition
EU/national routes, tax/insurance and locality-cost evidence
employer-led work routes and compact national rule system
emirate/federal variation, employer-led status and mandatory insurance variation
route-based immigration, national tax/health rules and regulated professions
federal immigration/tax plus state/local housing, health and licensing variation

anchor_rule: Anchors test source and rule diversity; they are not a production-supported destination promise. All 91 stable destinations still receive an explicit research support state.
global_protocol: Freeze construct, route inventory boundary and candidate-specific support floor before measuring outcomes.
Prefer primary official authorities; aggregators may discover or cross-check but cannot replace exact official rules.
Capture exact asset/URL identity, publisher, access path, terms, attribution, effective dates, checksums and conflict policy.
Separate lawful access, internal snapshot retention, normalized derivative use and public redistribution conclusions.
Use only synthetic applicant, household and scenario fixtures.
Prove deterministic parsing/evaluation and offline replay without runtime browsing, LLMs or profile-by-country matrices.
Treat missing input as INPUT_REQUIRED and unsupported evidence as unsupported, never as a negative applicant outcome.
Record refresh owner, cadence, change detection and realistic manual-review burden.

candidates.exact_user_question: Which supported skilled-work routes match this explicit snapshot, and what is missing or unmet?
source_plan: national immigration and labour authority route inventories
EU Immigration Portal only as bounded discovery/cross-check
exact_probe_scope: named route IDs and open/suspended state
candidates.recommended_premeasurement_floor: At least 6/8 anchors and 20/91 stable destinations fully assessable from official sources, or an owner-approved bounded subset of at least 12 destinations with explicit unsupported states.
candidates.safe_negative_boundary: No supported route matched only when the frozen supported route inventory is complete for the snapshot date.

candidates.exact_user_question: Can the declared household roles accompany or reunify under a supported route, and what conditions and work rights apply?
source_plan: national immigration authority dependant/accompaniment and reunification rules
official dependant and partner work-right rules
EU Immigration Portal only as bounded cross-check
candidates.recommended_premeasurement_floor: At least 6/8 anchors and 20/91 stable destinations fully assessable for one frozen primary-route family, with all other route families explicit as unsupported.
candidates.safe_negative_boundary: No supported family route matched is limited to the declared primary route/status and household roles.

candidates.exact_user_question: Does this institution, qualification and study scenario match a supported post-study work or stay route?
source_plan: official application-window, work-right and transition rules
candidates.recommended_premeasurement_floor: At least 6/8 anchors and 15/91 stable destinations fully assessable from official routes and institution/qualification registers.
candidates.safe_negative_boundary: No supported route matched only for completed/current study facts and a complete destination route inventory; planned future graduation remains provisional.

candidates.exact_user_question: Which supported permanent or settled residence pathways match now or conditionally, and which requirements remain?
source_plan: national immigration authority residence/settlement route inventories
regional authorities where routes are delegated
candidates.recommended_premeasurement_floor: At least 6/8 anchors and 20/91 stable destinations fully assessable for a frozen set of employment/study-to-residence route families.
candidates.safe_negative_boundary: Future pathway is conditional, not promised; no-match applies only to supported routes and supplied history.

candidates.exact_user_question: For this bounded profession, qualification origin and jurisdiction, what supported recognition and licensing steps apply?
source_plan: ENIC-NARIC only for bounded recognition context
candidates.recommended_premeasurement_floor: At least two precisely defined profession families across at least 5/8 anchors, with one explicit regulator/jurisdiction record per supported combination.
candidates.safe_negative_boundary: Report unmet or unsupported requirements; never claim the applicant cannot practise outside the frozen protected scope and regulator route.

candidates.exact_user_question: Under this employment and household scenario, what employee income tax and mandatory deductions are estimated?
source_plan: national tax authority statutes, tables and official calculators
OECD Taxing Wages for bounded benchmark/reconciliation only
exact_probe_scope: allowances/deductions in frozen supported household models
candidates.recommended_premeasurement_floor: At least 6/8 anchors and 20/91 stable destinations with reproducible official parameters for one frozen employee household model and tax year.
candidates.safe_negative_boundary: Return an estimate/range with assumptions and excluded filing circumstances; never tax advice or a guaranteed payslip.

candidates.exact_user_question: For this target locality, household and housing assumption, what supported housing-cost range and income/budget share apply?
minimum_inputs: gross/net income or budget and currency
source_plan: official national/local rent or housing-cost distributions
OECD housing data for cross-check only
candidates.recommended_premeasurement_floor: At least 6/8 anchors and 20 canonical cities across at least 12 stable destinations with like-for-like official rental evidence.
candidates.safe_negative_boundary: Report a sourced range and ratio, not availability, neighbourhood fit or a promise that housing can be secured.

candidates.exact_user_question: Under this immigration/status and household scenario, what required system-level healthcare costs can be estimated and what is excluded?
minimum_inputs: household size/child ages where premiums vary
source_plan: health ministries and national health services
exact_probe_scope: excluded personal medical need and voluntary coverage
candidates.recommended_premeasurement_floor: At least 6/8 anchors and 20/91 stable destinations with reproducible official eligibility and mandatory-cost parameters for one frozen status/household model.
candidates.safe_negative_boundary: Estimate required system costs only; do not collect health conditions or estimate personal treatment needs/out-of-pocket events.

phase_gate: Proceed to Phase 7C only if at least three candidates are PRODUCTION_QUALIFIED_FIRST_WAVE without weakening any gate; prefer three to five and at least two result families. Otherwise close Phase 7 as research-only.
